rationale: card #139 focus-visible restoration: replaced outline:none + box-shadow :focus rule with a visible :focus-visible ring (outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px) on all interactive elements (a, button, input, select, textarea, summary, [tabindex]) plus a form-control :focus-visible rule preserving border-color + box-shadow. 46-byte gzip increase from the added grouped outline rule. :focus-visible is supported across the entire browserslist (Safari 15.4+, iOS 15.4+, latest Chrome/Firefox/Edge), so no :focus fallback is needed.
